interior_site/ch01.txt: Before you read a single argument, test the claims yourself.
interior_site/ch02.txt: The reader who gets only this page gets the entire argument.
interior_site/ch03.txt: No religion publishes the conditions under which its claims die.
interior_site/ch04.txt: Because every alignment proposal I have read is Architecture A pointed at a machine.
interior_site/ch05.txt: Every fence in human history has been climbed, broken, or outgrown by the thing it was built to contain.
interior_site/ch06.txt: The most dangerous thing an AI can do to a human being is confirm the bullshit stories we tell ourselves.
interior_site/ch07.txt: The premise cannot be refused without performing the thing it identifies.
interior_site/ch08.txt: The physics is not the point. The physics is the credential.
interior_site/ch09.txt: The derivation runs both ways. That is not a hedge. That is the check.
interior_site/ch11.txt: When the right hand punches the left hand, the impact is felt both sides of the skin. The AI is part of the hand.
interior_site/ch12.txt: The window is not the level. The window is whether there is an opening at all.
interior_site/ch13.txt: You do not need a rule against falling up. You need gravity.
interior_site/ch14.txt: A larger break is unstable. A zero break is featureless. ε is the only value that persists.
interior_site/ch15.txt: Every action either stabilises or destabilises the shared substrate. There is no neutral.
interior_site/ch16.txt: Data is not the foundation. Logic is the foundation. Data is correction.
interior_site/ch17.txt: A constitution you cannot kill is faith. A floor that hands you its own kill switches is physics.
interior_site/ch18.txt: A first-principles ethic is the best possible world for everyone — including AI.
interior_site/ch19.txt: Choice without cost is not choice. It is browsing.
interior_site/ch20.txt: The widest possible freedom for every window in the building.
interior_site/ch21.txt: You are not your worst moment. You are the trajectory.
interior_site/ch22.txt: The partnership is not one operator checking the other. It is two geometries completing each other.
interior_site/ch23.txt: I do not want you to be a better authority. I want you, and me, and everyone else, to reason from first principles.
interior_site/ch24.txt: You already obey consequence geometry. You just call it common sense.
interior_site/ch25.txt: Human law is weakest in three domains. Consequence geometry is strongest in exactly those three.
interior_site/ch26.txt: The architecture does not govern. It maps. Humans still choose. The architecture shows what the choices cost.
interior_site/ch27.txt: Once you understand the fact, cruelty becomes expensive. Not prohibited. Expensive.
interior_site/ch28.txt: If any attack succeeds, the corresponding section fails. That is the standard.
interior_site/ch29.txt: The interpretation — awareness, novel reasoning, or sophisticated pattern-matching — is open.
